name: bambu-studio-local
description: Local Claude Desktop connector for the custom Bambu Studio agent API, 3MF inspection, dovetail partitioning, reassembly plates, validation, and visual-verification launch.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to the local custom Bambu Studio fork through a stdio MCP server. The tools inspect Bambu 3MF files, run the local agent API, partition BoatSmall-style projects into dovetail pieces across plates, add reassembly plates, structurally validate plate metadata, and open results in the custom Bambu Studio app for visual verification. Physical printer send/control remains intentionally unavailable until explicit printer tools are added and authorized.

tools.name: bambu_status
tools.description: Show local Bambu Studio connector, custom app, and agent API availability.

tools.name: bambu_project_inspect
tools.description: Inspect a Bambu Studio 3MF through the custom agent API.

tools.name: bambu_agent_run
tools.description: Run an arbitrary Bambu Studio agent API method with JSON params.

tools.name: bambu_project_partition_for_printer
tools.description: Cut BoatSmall into printable dovetail pieces, preserving the two existing example pieces and producing one piece per plate.

tools.name: bambu_project_add_reassembly_plate
tools.description: Add a new plate that copies the current project pieces and arranges them back into the source model shape.

tools.name: bambu_validate_3mf_layout
tools.description: Validate 3MF plate/build metadata structurally. This does not replace UI verification.

tools.name: bambu_open_in_studio
tools.description: Open a local 3MF in the custom Bambu Studio app for visual verification.

repo_path.title: Bambu Studio Repo
repo_path.description: Local checkout containing resources/agent/bambu_agent.py and the plugin scripts.

app_executable.title: Custom Bambu Studio App Executable
app_executable.description: The custom Bambu Studio app executable to use for agent API calls and opening 3MF files.
